# Endless Tech - UK Technology Training & Consulting

> Endless Tech (Endless Technologies) is a UK-based technology company providing IT Training, Software Development, Cloud Services, AI & Data Analytics, and Technology Consulting. Motto: "Learn Today. Build Tomorrow."

## Core Capabilities & Services

- [IT Training & Certifications](/services/it-training): Industry-focused IT training for AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Python, React, AI & Machine Learning, and Cybersecurity with 95% pass rate.
- [Software Development](/services/software-development): Custom web, mobile, and enterprise software solutions built with React 18, Next.js 14, Node.js, and Python.
- [Cloud Services](/services/cloud-services): AWS & Azure migration, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), Kubernetes orchestration, and 24/7 cloud security.
- [AI & Data Analytics](/services/ai-data-analytics): Predictive machine learning models, Power BI business intelligence, data engineering pipelines, and custom LLM integration.
- [Technology Consulting](/services/technology-consulting): Strategic technology advisory, digital transformation planning, cloud adoption roadmaps, and software architecture audits.

## Training Academy

- [Professional Courses](/training): Certification preparation for AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator, Full-Stack Development, and AI Engineering.
- [UK HQ Location](/about): Based in London, UK. 100% UK GDPR compliant with UK-based senior engineers and trainers.
